beats.say: A polar bear's fur isn't actually white.
Each hair is clear, like fishing line.
Light bounces around inside, so it looks white.
And under all that fur, its skin is black.
It's the biggest meat eater that lives on land.
But it spends a lot of its life in the sea.
The law even counts it as a marine mammal.
A white bear that isn't white, with black skin.
